games.title: Stick Hero
games.description: oin the epic adventure in Stick Hero! Solve math logic puzzles, defeat monsters with lower power numbers, collect weapons, and upgrade your hero. Can you conquer the tower? Play now!
games.long_description: Stick Hero is an addictive puzzle and strategy game that combines classic stickman themes with engaging math logic mechanics. In this captivating 2D cartoon adventure, players control a brave stickman hero tasked with climbing towers filled with dangerous monsters, shiny treasures, and captive princesses. Your power is represented by a number above your head. To survive and conquer, you must strategically drag your hero to attack enemies with lower numbers, absorbing their power to grow stronger. As you progress, the towers become more complex, requiring careful calculation and logical thinking to determine the correct order of attacks. Collect powerful swords, unlock epic skins, and fight massive bosses in the arena. Perfect for players who love brain-teasing puzzles combined with RPG elements, Stick Hero offers endless hours of strategic fun and decompression. Math & Logic Puzzles: Use addition and simple math to defeat enemies and grow your hero's power number. Strategic Tower Climbing: Plan your attack route carefully. One wrong move against a stronger enemy means game over! Rich RPG Elements: Collect epic weapons, unlock cool hero skins, and level up your character for tougher battles. Diverse Game Modes: Enjoy puzzle-solving tower levels and test your overall strength in the endless arena survival mode. Playing Stick Hero is all about strategy and simple math. When you start a level, you will see your stickman hero on one side of the screen and a multi-level tower on the other. Both your hero and the enemies have numbers hovering over their heads, representing their current combat power. Your goal is to clear the tower of all enemies and rescue the princess or claim the ultimate treasure. To do this, you must drag and drop your hero onto a floor containing an enemy or an item. Here is the golden rule: you can only defeat an enemy if your power number is strictly higher than theirs. When you successfully defeat a monster, your hero absorbs its power, adding the enemy's number to your own. This makes you strong enough to take on the next, tougher opponent. Therefore, the key to winning is choosing the correct order of attacks. Always look for the weakest enemy first to build up your stats. Sometimes, floors contain weapons like swords or specific power-ups. Grabbing these items will give your hero a massive boost in power, allowing you to bypass certain math constraints or easily defeat high-level bosses. Beware! If you accidentally drop your hero onto an enemy with a higher power number, you will lose the battle and have to restart the level. As you earn coins from victories, use them in the main menu to unlock powerful new skins and weapons. Calculate the numbers and plan your path to victory! Drag and Drop: Tap and hold your hero, drag them to the desired room or enemy in the tower, and release your finger to attack or collect the item. Q: Why did my hero die when attacking an enemy? A: Your hero's power number must be greater than the enemy's number. If your number is equal to or lower than the enemy's, you will fail the attack. Q: How can I beat boss enemies with very high numbers? A: You need to defeat smaller enemies first to add their numbers to yours, or look for weapon power-ups (like swords) on other floors before facing the boss. Q: What are the gold coins used for? A: Coins earned from completing levels can be used in the shop menu to unlock new cosmetic skins and start the game with cool appearances.

controls.Controls: Drag and Drop: Tap and hold your hero, drag them to the desired room or enemy in the tower, and release your finger to attack or collect the item.

games.description: Play SortPuz 3D, a relaxing and addictive water sort puzzle game! Pour colored liquids into bottles until each bottle has only one color. Train your brain, unlock beautiful skins, and climb the leaderboard for free online!
games.long_description: Welcome to SortPuz 3D, a highly addictive and visually pleasing water sort puzzle game designed to train your brain and soothe your mind. Your objective is simple yet challenging: sort various colored liquids mixed in different glass bottles until each bottle contains only one solid color. As you progress through the hundreds of levels, the puzzles become increasingly complex, requiring careful planning and logical thinking. The game features smooth pouring animations, a relaxing ASMR-like sound design, and a vibrant pastel aesthetic. Beyond the puzzles, you can collect coins to unlock a wide variety of stylish bottle shapes, beautiful background themes, and even unique avatars. Compete with players worldwide on the leaderboard and prove your sorting skills. Whether you need a quick mental workout or a relaxing escape, SortPuz 3D is the perfect casual puzzle experience! Brain-Teasing Logic: Exercise your mind by planning the perfect moves to sort mixed colored liquids into single-color bottles. Relaxing Experience: Enjoy soothing gameplay with no time limits, aesthetic pastel visuals, and satisfying pouring sounds. Rich Customization: Earn coins to unlock new bottle designs, scenic backgrounds, and player avatars in the shop. Endless Levels: Challenge yourself with hundreds of progressively difficult levels that keep your brain engaged. Global Leaderboard: Complete levels to earn score points and compete against other players on the worldwide ranking. Playing SortPuz 3D is simple to understand but requires strategic thinking to master. When a level starts, you will see several glass bottles filled with layers of different colored liquids. There will also be one or two completely empty bottles. Your goal is to reorganize the liquids by pouring them back and forth until every bottle either holds only one single color or is completely empty. To make a move, first tap on the bottle you want to pour liquid from. It will lift slightly. Then, tap on the destination bottle you want to pour the liquid into. However, there are two very important rules you must follow: You can only pour water into a bottle if it has enough empty space at the top. You can only pour water on top of another liquid if both are the exact same color. If the receiving bottle is completely empty, you can pour any color into it. You need to plan your moves carefully. If you get stuck and cannot make any more valid moves, you will have to restart the level. You can use the "Undo" button to reverse your previous move, or use the "+1 Bottle" booster to add an extra empty bottle to the board, making the puzzle significantly easier. Complete levels with fewer moves to earn more coins, and use those coins in the shop to customize your game! Select/Pour: Tap or click on a bottle to select it, then tap or click on another bottle to pour the liquid. Q: Why can't I pour the water into another bottle? A: You can only pour water if the destination bottle has enough empty space AND the top layer of liquid in the destination bottle matches the color you are pouring. Q: What should I do if I get completely stuck? A: You can use the "Undo" button to take back your last few moves, or tap the "Add Bottle" icon to get an extra empty tube to help you sort. You can also restart the level at any time. Q: How do I unlock new backgrounds and bottle shapes? A: Completing levels rewards you with gold coins. You can spend these coins in the in-game shop (found on the main menu) to purchase new skins, backgrounds, and avatars.

controls.Controls: Select/Pour: Tap or click on a bottle to select it, then tap or click on another bottle to pour the liquid.

games.long_description: WC Waiting Line is a clever and addictive 2D puzzle game that puts your logic and color-matching skills to the test in a hilarious everyday scenario. The game features a crowded line of people waiting for the restroom, each wearing a specific color. Your goal is to tap them into the available toilet stalls at the top. However, there's a catch: a character will only leave the stall (be cleared) if their color matches the toilet paper currently assigned to that stall. With limited toilet slots available, you must carefully plan the order of your taps. If all the stalls are filled with characters who don't match the paper colors, the line gets stuck and the game is over! It's a perfect blend of spatial management and color matching that offers a satisfyingly "Zen" experience as you clear the chaotic crowd. Color Matching Logic: Match character outfits with corresponding toilet paper colors to clear slots and keep the line moving. Strategic Slot Management: Think ahead before you tap! Limited toilet stalls mean every move counts to avoid a gridlock. Relaxing 2D Visuals: Enjoy clean, minimalist 2D graphics and smooth animations that make sorting a breeze. Endless Puzzle Fun: Tackle increasingly complex queues and color combinations as you progress through the levels. In WC Waiting Line, your mission is to clear the entire queue by matching colors. At the top of the screen, you'll see a row of toilet stalls, each with a colored roll of toilet paper above it. Below, characters of various colors are waiting in line. Tap on the character at the front of the line to move them into an empty stall. If the character's color matches the toilet paper color of that stall, they will be cleared instantly, earning you points and freeing up the stall. If the colors don't match, the character will stay in the stall, taking up a valuable slot. You must analyze the upcoming colors in the queue and match them strategically with the paper available. Clear all characters to win the level! Tap/Click on a character to send them to the next available toilet stall. No camera movement or complicated gestures required. Q: What happens if all my toilet stalls are full? A: If every stall is occupied by a character that doesn't match the paper color, you can no longer move the line, and the game ends. Q: Can I choose which stall a character goes to? A: No, characters usually fill the available stalls from left to right or in a specific sequence. You must plan based on that order. Q: Is there a time limit? A: Most levels don't have a countdown timer, so you can take your time to think about the best sequence.

games.title: City Take Over
games.description: Draw lines to connect buildings, deploy your cute bear army, and conquer the city! Test your strategy in this fun, fast-paced territory takeover game. Play now!
games.long_description: "City Takeover" is a delightful and addictive strategy game that puts a cute spin on real-time territory control. You command an army of adorable, weapon-wielding teddy bears with one simple goal: take over every building on the map! The game mechanics are incredibly intuitive. You start with a blue building that generates bears over time. By drawing a line from your building to an enemy (red) or neutral (gray) building, you send your bears marching to attack or occupy it. But beware, the enemy will also send their bears to attack you! You must strategically manage your forces, cut enemy supply lines, and capture buildings to increase your production rate. With its vibrant 3D graphics, easy-to-learn line-drawing controls, and hundreds of increasingly complex levels, this game offers endless tactical fun for players of all ages. Intuitive Line Drawing: Simply swipe to connect buildings and deploy your bear troops. Strategic Takeovers: Manage numbers and choose the right time to attack or defend. Cute Bear Army: Lead a squad of adorable teddy bears into battle. Progressive Difficulty: Face smarter AI and more complex map layouts as you level up. Multiple Building Types: Capture neutral grey buildings or engage in fierce battles for red ones. Offline Mode: Enjoy the tactical battles anywhere without needing Wi-Fi. The objective is to conquer all buildings on the screen. The number on each building represents the number of bears inside. Generating Bears: Your blue buildings will slowly increase their bear count over time. Attacking: Tap your blue building and drag a line to an enemy (red) or neutral (gray) building. Your bears will start marching along this path. When they reach the target, they will reduce the target's number. When the target's number hits 0, you capture it, and it turns blue! Defending: If an enemy is sending bears to your building, you can draw a line from another one of your buildings to send reinforcements, or you can draw a line directly across the enemy's path to make your bears fight theirs in the middle. Cutting Lines: You can cut a connection by quickly swiping across the path you drew. This stops your bears from marching. Winning: Capture all red and gray buildings. The level is complete when the entire map is blue and displays "MAX". Drag & Drop: Touch a friendly building and drag to a target building to connect them. Swipe: Swipe across an existing path to cut the connection and stop the troop movement. Q: What do the grey buildings do? A: Gray buildings are neutral and do not attack. Capturing them is easier than capturing red buildings, and once captured, they will generate troops for you. Q: Can I connect one building to multiple targets? A: Yes! You can draw lines from one of your buildings to several other buildings, distributing your troops among them. Q: How do I beat levels with lots of enemies? A: Focus on capturing neutral buildings first to increase your overall troop production rate before attacking heavily defended enemy positions.

controls.Controls: Drag & Drop: Touch a friendly building and drag to a target building to connect them. Swipe: Swipe across an existing path to cut the connection and stop the troop movement.

games.title: Solo Hit Run
games.description: Play Solo Hit Run, an exciting 3D hyper-casual runner! Swipe to dodge high-level enemies, slash weaker ones to level up your stickman, and conquer the multiplier track. Play free online now!
games.long_description: Welcome to the fast-paced and thrilling world of Solo Hit Run, an addictive 3D hyper-casual runner game! In this exciting stickman adventure, you control a weapon-wielding hero sprinting forward on an endless track. Your primary goal is to grow stronger by defeating enemies with a lower level than yours while skillfully dodging those who are too powerful to fight. Every successful hit increases your character's level, making you grow larger and allowing you to take on tougher opponents. Along the way, you must avoid deadly traps like sharp spikes that will instantly end your run. Reach the end of the track to unleash your built-up power in a satisfying multiplier bonus round, kicking enemies as far as possible for massive gem rewards. With simple swipe controls, colorful 3D graphics, and a fun skin collection system, Solo Hit Run offers a perfect stress-relieving experience for everyone! Level-Up Mechanics: Defeat weaker enemies on the track to absorb their power and instantly increase your own level. Dodge and Survive: Swipe quickly to avoid deadly floor spikes and high-level boss enemies that can crush you. Multiplier Finish Line: Use your accumulated level to push enemies down the bonus track for massive score multipliers. Skin Collection: Open chests and use your collected gems to unlock cool new stickman skins and weapons. Hyper-Casual Fun: Enjoy easy-to-learn, one-finger controls perfect for quick and relaxing gameplay sessions. Starting your adventure in Solo Hit Run is very simple, but mastering the track requires quick reflexes and sharp observation. When the game begins, your stickman hero starts running forward automatically. You will notice a level number floating above your character's head (for example, "Lv 1"). As you run down the path, you will encounter various colorful enemies, each with their own level numbers. The golden rule of this game is simple: you can only attack and defeat enemies whose level is lower than your current level. When you slash a weaker enemy, your level increases, making your character grow larger and stronger. This allows you to hunt down the bigger enemies further down the track. However, you must be careful! If you accidentally run into an enemy with a higher level than yours, your character will be defeated, and you will fail the stage. You must also keep a sharp eye out for environmental hazards, such as black spikes scattered across the road. Hitting these obstacles will instantly end your run. Your goal is to reach the finish line with the highest level possible. Once you cross the finish line, you enter the bonus phase. Here, your character will automatically sprint down a multiplier track, pushing enemies forward. The higher your level, the further you will push them, landing on massive multipliers (like x1.5, x2.0, etc.) to dramatically increase your gem rewards. Use these gems in the main menu to upgrade your starting level or unlock epic new skins! Move: Tap and hold the screen (or left-click and hold your mouse), then swipe left or right to move your character across the track. Running and attacking are automatic. Q: Why did I die when I hit an enemy? A: You can only safely attack enemies with a lower level than yours. If you hit an enemy with a higher number, you will lose the level! Always aim for the smaller numbers. Q: How do I unlock new characters and weapons? A: You can unlock new visual skins by collecting purple gems during your runs and spending them in the "Skin" menu located on the home screen. Q: What is the purpose of the end-of-level track? A: The final track is a bonus zone that multiplies your gem rewards. The higher your character's level is when you cross the finish line, the further you will push the enemies, resulting in a much bigger multiplier!

games.title: Bubble Jam
games.description: Organize numbered tiles in perfect sequence in Bubble Jam! Arrange blocks from high to low or low to high to merge and clear the board. A satisfying and brain-teasing 3D sorting challenge.
games.long_description: Bubble Jam is a sophisticated and highly satisfying 3D puzzle game that reinvents the sorting genre. Unlike traditional matching games, your success depends on your ability to organize numbered hexagonal tiles in a logical sequence. The core objective is to stack blocks onto a 3D grid in either ascending (1-2-3...) or descending (...3-2-1) order. When a proper sequence is formed, the tiles will collapse into each other, merging into a higher-value block or clearing from the field, creating a delightful chain reaction. The game starts with a few basic numbers but quickly introduces complex layouts and restricted spaces that require strategic foresight. With its clean 3D visuals, smooth animations, and zen-like atmosphere, Hexa Sort offers a perfect mental workout for players who love organization and numerical challenges. Can you keep the grid tidy and master the ultimate number sequence? Sequential Stacking Mechanics: A unique twist on sorting where tiles must be arranged in numerical order to trigger a merge. Satisfying Collapse Effects: Experience the visual joy of watching long numerical chains fold and disappear. Spatial Logic Challenge: Plan your placements on a hexagonal grid to maximize space and efficiency. Calming 3D Aesthetic: Enjoy a clean, minimalist design with smooth physics and soothing color palettes. Bubble Jamt is to clear the board by organizing numbered tiles into sequences. Look at the numbered hexagonal blocks provided at the bottom of the screen. Tap or drag them onto the 3D grid. To trigger a merge or elimination, you must place the blocks such that they form a sequence (e.g., placing a '2' next to a '3', or a '4' next to a '3'). The sequence can be ascending or descending. Once a valid chain is established, the blocks will automatically stack onto the highest or lowest number in that chain. Plan your moves to ensure you don't block future sequences or fill the entire grid, which would result in a game over. Use boosters to undo moves or clear troublesome blocks when the grid gets too crowded! Simply tap a numbered block and then tap the desired spot on the grid to place it. Q: Can I stack numbers in any order? A: No, they must follow a strict ascending or descending order (like 4-3-2 or 1-2-3) to trigger the stacking effect. Q: What happens if I fill the grid? A: If there is no space left to place a new block and no more sequences can be formed, the game ends. Q: Is there a way to move blocks after they are placed? A: Usually, once a block is placed, it cannot be moved unless you use a special "Swap" or "Undo" booster.

controls.Controls: Simply tap a numbered block and then tap the desired spot on the grid to place it.

The game utilizes the classic "Onet" or "Connect" mechanics: your goal is to clear the board by finding and connecting pairs of identical food tiles, such as delicious pizzas, fresh fruits, and tasty sushi. The catch? The connecting line between the two tiles can only have a maximum of two 90-degree turns! With its vibrant cartoon graphics, soothing background music, and progressively challenging levels divided into chapters, this game offers the perfect way to unwind and train your brain. Collect stars to unlock special gifts, spin the lucky wheel, and help the chef complete his grand cake masterpiece! Classic Onet Gameplay: Connect 2 identical tiles with up to 3 straight lines. Relaxing Vibe: Stress-free puzzle-solving with colorful 2D cartoon graphics. The objective of the game is to remove all the food tiles from the board within the given rules. Matching: Look for two identical tiles on the board (e.g., two bananas or two pizzas). Connecting: Tap one tile to select it, then tap the identical matching tile. games.title: Jelly Merge
games.description: Swipe to slide and merge same-colored jellies in Jelly Merge! Use the tricky terrain, solve brain-teasing spatial puzzles, and clear complex levels in this relaxing game.
games.long_description: Welcome to Jelly Merge, a brilliantly designed puzzle game that will put your spatial logic and strategic thinking to the test! In this vibrant and colorful brain-teaser, your objective is to merge all patches of liquid jelly that share the same color. By swiping up, down, left, or right, you command all jellies on the board to slide simultaneously until they hit a wall or another object. When two jellies of the same color collide, they merge into one! As you progress, the game introduces highly complex terrains, labyrinth-like maps, and multiple colors that you must manage at once. You will need to cleverly use the environment's corners and obstacles to block certain jellies while moving others into the perfect position. With its satisfying jiggly animations, stress-relieving mechanics, and progressively challenging levels, Jelly Merge is the ultimate puzzle experience! Spatial Logic Puzzles: Exercise your brain by predicting how all jellies will slide and interact with the terrain simultaneously. Terrain Utilization: Cleverly use walls, corners, and dead ends to manipulate specific colors into merging. Progressive Difficulty: Face increasingly complex maps with more colors and intricate obstacle layouts. Satisfying Mechanics: Enjoy the stress-relieving visual feedback as colorful liquid blocks squash and merge together. Jelly Merge is incredibly easy to control but requires a sharp mind to master. Here is your guide to solving the colorful mazes: Step 1: Analyze the Board. Before making a move, look at where the different colored jellies are located and study the layout of the walls and obstacles. Step 2: Swipe to Slide. Swipe your finger in any of the four directions (Up, Down, Left, Right). Important: All jellies on the board will slide in that direction at the exact same time! They will only stop when they hit a wall, the edge of the map, or another jelly. Step 3: Merge the Colors. Your goal is to make jellies of the exact same color touch each other. When they collide, they merge into a larger piece. You win the level when all jellies of the same color have been successfully combined into single blocks. Step 4: Use the Obstacles. Since all jellies move together, you must use the walls to "catch" or stagger certain jellies. For example, swipe Left to push a blue jelly into a corner, then swipe Up to move a second blue jelly toward it without moving the first one. Step 5: Plan Ahead. One wrong swipe can get a jelly permanently stuck in the wrong corner or block a crucial pathway. Think one or two moves ahead to avoid dead ends! Swipe: Touch the screen and swipe Up, Down, Left, or Right to slide every jelly on the board in that corresponding direction. Q: What happens if a jelly gets stuck behind a different color? A: If your path is completely blocked and you cannot use the terrain to separate them, you are stuck! You will need to use the "Restart" button to try the level again with a different strategy. Q: Is there a time limit or move limit? A: Usually, there is no time limit. You can take your time to carefully analyze the map and plan your logical swipes without any pressure. Q: Can I move just one jelly at a time? A: No, that is the core puzzle mechanic! A single swipe applies gravity/movement to all jellies on the map simultaneously. You must use the walls to isolate their movements.

controls.Controls: Swipe: Touch the screen and swipe Up, Down, Left, or Right to slide every jelly on the board in that corresponding direction.

By drawing the exact shapes or symbols shown on their balloons! Swipe your finger across the screen to draw horizontal lines, V-shapes, zig-zags, and more to pop the balloons and send the wolves crashing down. The game features a "Level Mode" filled with progressively challenging stages and an "Endless Mode" where you can test your reflexes for high scores. With its simple yet highly addictive draw-to-pop mechanic, vibrant 2D cartoon graphics, and thrilling survival gameplay, Wolf Invasion is the perfect hyper-casual game to test your speed and accuracy. Draw fast and save the day! Draw to Attack: Swipe on the screen to draw specific shapes matching the balloon symbols to pop them instantly. Physics-Based Bouncing: Utilize realistic bullet ricochets off walls to hit zombies hiding in tricky corners. Interactive Environments: Shoot explosive TNT barrels to trigger massive chain reactions and save your ammo. Brain-Teasing Puzzles: Calculate the perfect geometric angles to clear the entire stage with just one bullet. Limited Ammo Challenge: Test your logic and precision, as every missed shot brings you closer to failure. Mastering Zombie Sharp Shooter requires you to treat your gun like a geometry tool. Here is how to solve the undead puzzles: Step 1: Analyze the Room. Before you shoot, look at where the zombies are placed. Notice any solid walls your bullets can bounce off of, and look for hazards like TNT barrels or heavy objects hanging above the enemies. Step 2: Aim and Predict. Tap and hold the screen. A laser sight will appear, showing you the exact path your bullet will take, including its first bounce off a wall. Move your finger to adjust the angle perfectly. Step 3: Trigger Chain Reactions. Step 4: Release and Drop. Use this slow-motion slide to let the obstacle pass. As soon as the path is clear, release your finger to let the elevator resume its full-speed drop. Step 5: Reach the Ground. Successfully navigate past all the obstacles on the track until the elevator safely lands on the bottom platform. If you mistime your moves and crash into a beam, you must restart the level. Get a feel for the rhythm and aim for a flawless descent! Tap and Hold: Touch and hold the screen to apply the brakes, reducing your fall to a slow crawl. Release: Take your finger off the screen to drop at full speed. Global Leaderboard: Compete with players around the world and see your name rise in the rankings as you master the levels. Each territory you own automatically generates units, and the number on the map represents your current troop count. To expand, simply drag a line from your controlled territory to an adjacent neutral or enemy territory to launch an attack. Success depends on your ability to manage your resources, prioritize which areas to capture, and defend your borders against counter-attacks. With its vibrant, clean 2D cartoon graphics and addictive tactical mechanics, Territory Conqueror offers endless brain-teasing excitement. Can you outmaneuver your opponents, grow your force, and conquer the entire map? Tactical Path Connecting: Draw lines between territories to strategically march your army and capture enemy bases. Dynamic Troop Management: Balance your troop count between attacking new areas and defending your current ones. Incremental Growth: Watch your territories automatically generate units, making timing and area selection vital for victory. Strategic Upgrades: Enhance your starting unit count and production speed to build an unstoppable force. games.title: Lumber Hero Goblins Defense
games.description: Survive the horror forest in this addictive tower defense game! Gather resources by day, upgrade your heroes and defenses, and fight off terrifying monsters by night. Choose unique roguelike skills to build the ultimate camp and see how many days you can last.
games.long_description: Step into the "Horror Forest" and test your survival skills in this engaging blend of tower defense, idle resource gathering, and roguelike strategy! The game operates on a tense day-and-night cycle. During the day, your workers tirelessly mine gold and chop wood, providing you with the essential resources needed to fortify your camp. You can spend these resources to increase your heroes' attack damage, speed, range, or build catapults. When night falls, the real challenge begins: hordes of monsters will attack your camp from all directions! Your upgraded heroes and defenses must hold them off until dawn. To keep things fresh, every few days you survive, you get to choose from a selection of powerful, random roguelike abilities—like stunning enemies, increasing attack speed, or enhancing your fences. Can you build an impenetrable fortress and survive the terrifying boss fights that await? Day/Night Cycle: Gather resources safely during the day and prepare to defend your camp against monster waves at night. Roguelike Skill System: Choose from random powerful buffs every few days (e.g., Stun Missile, Rapid Shooter) to create unique defensive strategies. Resource Management: Mine gold and wood to continuously upgrade your damage, attack speed, and defenses. Boss Battles: Face off against giant, powerful monsters every 10 days to test your camp's true strength. Simple Controls: An intuitive interface makes upgrading and managing your defenses easy and accessible. Survival requires a balance of economy and defense. Here is your survival guide: Step 1: Gather Resources. During the "Day," your lumberjack and gold miner will automatically collect wood and gold. You can see your resources at the top left. Step 2: Upgrade Defenses. Use your gold to upgrade your heroes' base stats like "Damage," "Attack Speed," and "Attack Range" at the bottom of the screen. You can also use wood to upgrade your camp's fence or add new heroes. Step 3: Defend the Night. When the countdown ends, "Night Falls," and monsters will attack your camp. Your heroes will automatically attack the enemies. You can still upgrade stats during the battle if you have enough coins. Step 4: Choose Roguelike Skills. Offering a variety of distinct and challenging levels, your ultimate goal is to clear the intricately stacked boards by pairing identical tiles. Your objective is to remove all the tiles from the board to win the level. You remove tiles by matching them in identical pairs. However, there is a catch: you can only select "free" tiles. A tile is considered "free" and playable if it has no other tile resting on top of it, AND it has no other tile blocking it on either its left or right side. If a tile is squeezed tightly between two others horizontally, you cannot select it until you remove one of its neighbors. Simply scan the board for two matching free tiles and click them one after the other. They will disappear, revealing the tiles stacked beneath them. Keep an eye on the timer at the top. The faster you clear the board, the higher your time bonus and overall score will be, earning you up to 3 stars. If you make a mistake, use the "Undo" button at the bottom. If you can't find a match, use the "Hint" (lightbulb), or use "Shuffle" to rearrange the remaining tiles! Use the on-screen buttons at the bottom to trigger tools. Q: Why can't I click on a specific tile? A: You can only select "free" tiles. If a tile is covered by another tile, or if it has tiles touching both its left and right sides, it is blocked and cannot be matched yet. Q: Is there a time limit for the levels? A: Yes, there is a timer at the top of the screen. Clearing the board faster will reward you with a higher time bonus and a better star rating (up to 3 stars). Q: What should I do if there are no more matches left on the board? A: The game will usually notify you if no moves are left. You can use the "Shuffle" button (the crossed arrows) at the bottom right to rearrange the remaining tiles and create new matching opportunities.

In this unique casual game, you control a central core—like a cute planet or a funny face—surrounded by a rotating shield of deadly, yet delicious, ice creams and popsicles. Set against a beautiful starry space background, your mission is to survive and dominate the multiplayer arena. You must strategically expand and contract your spinning weapons to attack rival players while defending your own core. Defeating enemies causes them to drop their ice creams, which you can quickly collect to grow your arsenal and become an unstoppable spinning force. With its intuitive controls, vibrant 2D cartoon graphics, and competitive IO gameplay, Spin Ice Cream offers endless bite-sized entertainment. Jump into the arena, spin your way to victory, and become the ultimate champion! Thrilling IO Battles: Compete against other players in a fast-paced space arena to become the last one standing. Unique Spin Mechanics: Release your finger to expand your attacking radius, and hold to retract and defend your core. Grow Your Arsenal: Defeat opponents and collect their dropped ice creams to instantly increase your weapon count and power. Cute & Colorful Graphics: Enjoy vibrant 2D visuals featuring adorable planets, funny faces, and delicious-looking popsicles. Quick & Addictive: Perfect for short gaming sessions with its instant-play style and highly replayable competitive loop. Playing Spin Ice Cream is easy to learn but requires quick reflexes and good tactical timing to master. When you start a match, you are dropped into a circular space arena along with several other players. Your character consists of a central core surrounded by a few spinning ice creams. Your primary goal is to destroy your opponents' cores using your spinning weapons while strictly protecting your own. The controls are entirely based on tapping and holding the screen. By default, when you are not touching the screen, your ice creams spin in a wide, expanded orbit. This allows you to attack enemies from a distance. However, this also leaves your central core exposed and vulnerable to counterattacks. When you press and hold the screen, your ice creams will quickly retract and spin tightly around your core. This acts as a defensive shield, protecting you from incoming enemy strikes. You can navigate around the arena by dragging your finger while holding the screen. The core strategy lies in alternating between offense and defense. Approach an enemy while holding your defensive shield, then quickly release your finger to unleash a surprise expanding attack to shatter their core. When an enemy is destroyed, they drop all their weapons. Quickly rush over to collect these dropped ice creams! Every piece you collect adds to your own spinning circle, increasing both your defensive thickness and offensive reach. Keep moving, avoid getting surrounded by larger opponents, and aim to eliminate everyone else to claim the top spot on the leaderboard! Defend & Move: Click and hold the screen (or left mouse button) to retract your ice creams into a defensive shield, and drag to move your character. Attack: Release your finger (or mouse button) to expand your ice creams into a wide attacking orbit. Q: How do I get more ice creams spinning around me? A: You can increase your ice cream count by picking up the loose ones scattered in the arena, or by destroying other players and stealing theirs. Q: Why did I suddenly die? A: Your central core was hit by an opponent's spinning ice cream. You must hold the screen to retract your weapons and protect your core when enemies are getting too close! Q: Can I change my character's appearance? A: Yes! The game features a shop where you can use your earned points or view ads to unlock new core avatars (like different planets or emojis) and new styles of spinning weapons.

Every dollar earned can be reinvested into unlocking new room zones, upgrading furniture, or hiring specialized staff like cleaners to help you manage the increasing flow of visitors. With its colorful graphics, smooth animations, and intuitive gameplay, Hotel Party offers a highly satisfying mix of strategy and relaxation. Can you handle the pressure of being the boss and become the ultimate hotel tycoon? Fast-Paced Management: Experience the thrill of managing a busy hotel, from guest check-ins to room maintenance. Hiring & Automation: Build a reliable team by hiring cleaners and assistants to streamline your hotel operations. With its simple merge-2 mechanics, delightful 2D cartoon graphics, and endless progression, this game offers a relaxing yet engaging experience. Collect them all and become the ultimate pet master! Merge to Evolve: Combine two identical pets to unlock a higher-level creature with unique looks and stronger stats. games.description: Grab your weapons and become the ultimate Zombie Hunter! Shoot endless waves of the undead, upgrade your gear, and survive the apocalypse in this action-packed 3D game.
games.long_description: Welcome to Zombie Hunter, an adrenaline-pumping action shooter where you are humanity's last hope against the undead apocalypse! Armed to the teeth, your mission is to clear infected zones and survive relentless waves of terrifying zombies. Navigate through diverse 3D environments, keep a safe distance from the horde, and unleash heavy firepower to mow them down. As you eliminate enemies, you will collect gold coins and valuable resources. Use this loot to upgrade your weapons' damage and fire rate, unlock devastating new firearms, and boost your character's survivability. From rapid-fire assault rifles to heavy shotguns, choose the best arsenal that fits your playstyle. Featuring smooth controls, highly satisfying shooting mechanics, and intense mutant boss battles, Zombie Hunter delivers the ultimate arcade survival experience. Are you ready to hunt down the undead and save the world? Intense Zombie Shooting: Blast your way through endless hordes of the undead in fast-paced, action-packed levels. Hardcore Weapon Upgrades: Collect gold to unlock and upgrade a massive arsenal of deadly firearms and explosives. Challenging Boss Fights: Test your survival skills against giant mutated zombies with unique and deadly attack patterns. Satisfying Arcade Action: Enjoy smooth controls and visually pleasing hit feedback for the ultimate stress-relief experience. Starting your journey as a Zombie Hunter is intuitive, but surviving the later stages requires strategy and quick reflexes. Here is your ultimate survival guide: Step 1: Move and Kite. When the level starts, zombies will spawn and immediately track your position. Use the joystick to move around the map. Never stand in one place! Use the "kiting" technique: run away from the zombies to create distance, turn around to shoot, and run again. Step 2: Auto-Aim and Fire. Depending on the specific game mode, your character will either auto-aim at the nearest zombie, or you will use a secondary joystick/button to fire. Focus your fire on the fastest zombies first to prevent them from overwhelming you. Step 3: Collect Loot. Defeated zombies drop gold coins and occasionally health packs or temporary buffs (like double damage or invincibility). Quickly run over these items to pick them up, but don't walk directly into a zombie crowd to get them! Step 4: Upgrade in the Armory. After clearing a zone, you will return to the main menu. Go to the Armory and spend your hard-earned coins. You should regularly upgrade your weapon's "Damage" and "Fire Rate". If you take too much damage during levels, upgrade your "Max HP". Step 5: Defeat the Boss. At the end of certain stages, a massive Boss zombie will appear. Bosses have huge health bars and special attacks (like charging or throwing toxic sludge). Learn their attack patterns, dodge their abilities, and keep shooting until they go down! Surviving in Zombie Hunter is all about smart positioning and situational awareness. Here is your guide to dominating the undead: Step 1: Just Move! The moment the game starts, zombies will rush you. Use your thumb to move your character. You do not need a fire button—your hero will automatically shoot the zombies in range. Step 2: Kite the Horde. Never let the zombies surround you. Keep running in large circles (kiting) to gather the zombies into a tight group behind you, making them easier to manage. Step 3: Trigger the Barrels. Look out for red explosive barrels scattered around the stage. Don't shoot them immediately! Wait until a large group of zombies is walking right next to a barrel, then move so your auto-fire hits it for a massive multi-kill. Step 4: Grab the Airdrops. During the stage, supply drops will land from the sky. Rush to collect these airdrops! They will grant you powerful temporary buffs, such as increased fire rate, invincibility, or massive area damage, giving you the upper hand against the horde. Step 5: Survive and Clear. Keep moving, blowing up barrels, and utilizing airdrops until the zombie wave is completely wiped out to clear the level! Virtual Joystick (Drag): Touch the screen and swipe your finger to move your character. Shooting is 100% automatic! Just focus on steering clear of the zombies.

games.long_description: Draw Car 3D is an innovative hyper-casual game that ingeniously blends creative sketching with the thrill of physics-based racing. Unlike traditional racing games where you are confined to pre-made vehicles, here, you are the chief engineer. The game features a blank drawing canvas at the bottom of the screen; whatever shape you doodle instantly becomes the 3D chassis of your car. Your creation is then equipped with wheels and sent hurtling down a challenging track. The core challenge lies in the realistic physics engine: a long, flat line provides speed and stability, while a tall arch might be necessary to "step" over high obstacles or climb steep vertical walls. With hundreds of levels, various terrains like urban skylines, and a shop to customize your look, Draw Car 3D offers a satisfying mix of problem-solving and high-speed action. Real-time Transformation: Redraw your car shape at any moment during the race to adapt to changing terrain. Physics-Driven Logic: Use your understanding of gravity and leverage to design the most efficient car for climbing. For example, blue balls go to the blue side, green balls to the green side. As you progress, the game becomes more challenging with more balls appearing at once. You can score massive combos by sliding multiple balls of the same color simultaneously. With the coins you earn from achieving high scores, you can purchase upgrades like "Time Bonus for Correct Moves" or unlock adorable new ball skins like orange slices. "Color Sort Master" is the perfect hyper-casual game to kill time and sharpen your mind! Intuitive Sorting Gameplay: Simply swipe to match the ball color with the border color. Combo System: Slide multiple balls of the same color at once to maximize your score and combo meter. Upgrades & Buffs: Use coins to upgrade your time limits or reduce penalties for mistakes. Unlockable Skins: Customize your game by unlocking fun fruit skins for the balls. Fast-Paced Action: Keep up with the increasing speed as you clear the board. The goal of Minesweeper is to uncover all the empty squares on the grid without clicking on a mine. When you start a game, you will see a grid of covered squares. Flag Mode: Tap the "Flag" button at the bottom to toggle flag mode, then tap a square to mark it as a mine. Quick Reveal (Double-Tap): When a revealed number matches the number of surrounding flags, double-tap the number to quickly open all remaining unflagged adjacent squares. Q: Is it possible to have to guess? A: Most of the time, logic can solve the board. However, in some tricky situations, especially on higher difficulties, a 50/50 guess might be necessary to proceed. Q: How do I use the double-tap feature safely? A: If a numbered square says "2" and you have already flagged 2 adjacent squares, double-tapping the "2" will quickly uncover the rest. games.long_description: "Crazy Rugby.io" is an exciting, fast-paced sports game that brings the thrill of American football to a fun, hyper-casual multiplayer arena. In this game, you control a cute, 3D character in a fierce competition to score touchdowns. As soon as the match starts, players scramble to grab the football. Once you have it, you must skillfully dodge tackles from opposing players and make a mad dash for the end zone. If you are tackled, the ball drops, and the chase begins again! It is a game of quick reflexes, evasive maneuvers, and strategic teamwork (even if everyone is fighting for themselves). With its simple drag-to-move controls, competitive ranking system, and unlockable player skins, "Crazy Rugby.io" offers endless addictive gameplay for anyone looking for a quick sports challenge. Fast-Paced Action: Matches are quick, action-packed, and full of hilarious tackles. Simple Controls: Just tap and drag to move your character around the field. Competitive Ranking: Earn experience points (EXP) and climb the ranks from Bronze to higher tiers. Customization: Unlock and use different player outfits and unique footballs in the shop. .io Arena Style: Drop into a chaotic match with multiple opponents fighting for one ball. Playing "Crazy Rugby.io" is easy to learn but hard to master. Here is your playbook: Step 1: Enter the Match. Tap "Start" to be matched with other players. You will be placed on a green football field. Step 2: Grab the Ball. When the round begins, a football will appear. Run towards it and touch it to pick it up. Step 3: Run for the End Zone! If you have the ball, a colorful trail will follow you. Run towards the opposite end of the field (the end zone) to score a "Touchdown." Step 4: Dodge and Tackle. If you have the ball, avoid other players—if they touch you, you will drop the ball and be stunned for a moment. If another player has the ball, chase them down and run into them to tackle them and steal the ball! Step 5: Score the Most Points. The player or team with the most touchdowns when the timer runs out wins the match and gains EXP to rank up! Drag to Move: Press your finger anywhere on the screen and drag it in the direction you want your player to run. Release to stop. Q: Why do I drop the ball suddenly? A: You drop the ball if an opposing player gets close enough to "tackle" you. You have to keep moving and dodging to avoid them. Q: How do I get new characters? A: On the main screen, tap "Shop." You can unlock new players and balls, often by watching a short video ad or by reaching higher ranks. Q: Can I pass the ball to a teammate? A: In this fast-paced .io version, the focus is mostly on running the ball yourself. Try to use other players as shields to block your chasers!

controls.Controls: Drag to Move: Press your finger anywhere on the screen and drag it in the direction you want your player to run. Release to stop.

games.title: Rage Racing

games.long_description: Rage Racing is a high-stakes 3D game that masterfully blends rhythmic timing with spatial logic. The flagship Sprint Mode strips away traditional steering, challenging players to launch a fleet of cars through dynamic, vertically moving pipe gates with a single tap. Success is entirely dependent on your internal clock; the better your timing, the more cars you can guide through for a massive high-score combo. When you are ready for a strategic shift, Through Mode presents a gridlocked parking lot that requires careful planning. You must tap cars in the correct sequence to clear the lot without any collisions. With its minimalist one-click mechanics and vibrant visuals, Rage Racing provides a compelling loop of high-speed action and brain-teasing puzzles. It's an ideal experience for players who value precision and the satisfaction of a perfectly timed move. Master the rhythm, solve the jam, and dominate the leaderboards! One-Tap Rhythm Mastery：Forget steering; timing is your only weapon! Tap to launch cars at the exact moment the gates open. It's a pure test of observation and rhythmic precision. Dynamic Flow Challenge：In Sprint Mode, the goal is to get as many cars through the moving pipes as possible. Maintain a steady flow to multiply your score and set new records. Strategic Parking Logic：Transition to Through Mode for a mental workout. Solve complex traffic jams by deciding the perfect exit order for every vehicle in a congested 3D environment. Progressive Mode Unlocks：Prove your skills in basic modes to unlock the elite Challenge Mode at Level 20. The difficulty scales with your talent, offering endless replayability and deeper puzzles. Sprint Mode: Watch the dynamic pipe obstacles moving up and down. You cannot steer left or right; you must tap the screen at the precise moment the gates open to launch your cars. The more cars you successfully guide through in a row, the higher your score multiplier will be! Through Mode: This is a parking jam puzzle. Tap on cars to drive them out of the lot. You must ensure the path ahead of the car is clear of other vehicles or walls. Your goal is to clear the entire area in the correct logical order without a single collision. Pro Tips：In Sprint Mode, focus on the "Blink" of the opening gate. Tapping just as the pipes begin to separate gives you the widest window for your fleet. PC : Left Click. Use it to control the "launch timing" in Sprint Mode and the "exit sequence" in Through Mode. Mobile (Touch): Tap Screen. All actions can be completed with a single tap; no swiping or long-pressing required. Q: Why can't I steer left or right in Sprint Mode? A: This mode is designed as a timing challenge. The car drives straight; your goal is to time the launch to pass the moving gates. Q: How do I unlock the Challenge Mode? A: You must successfully reach and complete Level 20 in the Through Mode (Parking Jam).

controls.Controls: PC : Left Click. Use it to control the "launch timing" in Sprint Mode and the "exit sequence" in Through Mode. Mobile (Touch): Tap Screen. All actions can be completed with a single tap; no swiping or long-pressing required.

games.title: Spatial Vision
games.description: Challenge your spatial memory in Spatial Vision! Replicate complex patterns on the grid within seconds. How long can you keep the streak going in this intense brain trainer?
games.long_description: Spatial Vision is a fast-paced and intellectually demanding puzzle game designed to push your short-term memory and spatial reasoning to the edge. Set against a sleek, high-tech interface, players are tasked with memorizing a specific pattern of colored tiles on a small "radar" grid and then replicating it perfectly on a larger main grid. The difficulty ramps up quickly: after the initial rounds, the "radar" begins to tilt and rotate into 3D perspectives, forcing you to mentally rotate the pattern before clicking. With only 30 seconds on the clock and the pressure of maintaining a high-score combo, every tap counts. The game also features power-ups like "Time Extender" and "Clue Keys" to help you survive a "Difficulty Spike." Whether you want to sharpen your focus for work or simply prove your mental agility, Spatial Vision offers a rewarding and intense cognitive workout. Can you reach the legendary rounds and achieve the ultimate high score? Dynamic Memory Challenge: Memorize and replicate increasingly complex patterns under intense time pressure. 3D Spatial Rotation: Master the skill of mental rotation as patterns tilt and spin to test your visual-spatial processing. High-Tech Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a clean, minimalist 2D interface with stunning glowing effects. Strategic Power-ups: Use Clue Keys to reveal hints or Time Extenders to stay in the game during tough rounds. Your objective is to match the pattern shown on the small "radar" grid at the top left onto the large grid in the center. At the start of each round, you have a few seconds to observe the pattern. Then, tap the corresponding squares on the main grid to light them up. Be alert—as you progress, the radar may rotate 90, 180, or 270 degrees, or even tilt into a 3D view. You must mentally adjust the orientation to succeed. You have 30 seconds to complete as many rounds as possible. Correct placements earn points and build your "COMBO," while mistakes may waste time. If you get stuck, use the "Key" icon for a hint or the "Timer" icon to add more seconds. Reach high levels to unlock new patterns and push your brain to its limits! Simply tap or click on the grid squares to toggle the yellow light. Q: Why did I fail even though I clicked the right spots? A: Check the orientation of the radar! If the radar rotated, you must rotate your input on the main grid to match the new perspective. Q: How do I get more Time Extenders and Clue Keys? A: You can earn them by achieving high scores, or visit the "Shop" to get more using in-game currency or by watching rewarded videos. Q: What happens when the timer reaches zero? A: The game ends and your score is recorded. You can choose to restart or watch an ad to revive and continue from your current round.

games.long_description: Merge Mania is a highly engaging and relaxing grid-based puzzle game that offers a pure, strategic twist on the classic 2048 formula. Without the unpredictability of physics or bouncing mechanics, this game puts you in complete control of your logic and spatial planning. Players are presented with a vertical grid and a sequence of numbered blocks waiting to be placed. By simply tapping a column, the block slides straight into that lane. When two blocks with the exact same number touch, they instantly merge into a single block with double the value (e.g., two 8s become a 16). The ultimate goal is to carefully organize your grid to create massive chain reactions, continuously merging blocks to reach 2048 and far beyond! With its clean 2D aesthetics, soothing gameplay loop, and endless strategic depth, Merge Mania is the perfect stress-free brain-trainer for puzzle lovers. Grid-Based Logic: Place blocks in straight columns without unpredictable physics, relying entirely on your strategic planning. Classic 2048 Merging: Match two identical numbers to double their value, progressing from 2, 4, 8 all the way up to massive numbers. Satisfying Combos: Stack numbers in descending order to trigger thrilling, multi-stage chain reactions with a single move. Stress-Free Brain Training: Enjoy endless gameplay with no strict time limits, perfect for relaxing while sharpening your mind. Playing Merge Mania is incredibly intuitive, focusing purely on your strategic logic rather than reflexes. When you start the game, you will see an empty vertical grid divided into several columns. At the bottom (or top) of the screen, a new numbered block (like a 2, 4, or 8) will appear, waiting for your command. Your task is to decide which column this block should go into. Simply tap or click on your desired column, and the block will instantly move in a straight line down that lane until it rests against the wall or another block. The core rule is simple: if your placed block touches another block displaying the exact same number, they will automatically merge into one new block with double the value! For example, placing a "16" against another "16" creates a "32". The real strategy in Merge Mania is setting up combinations. You want to avoid placing large numbers on top of small numbers, as this will block the smaller ones from being merged. Instead, try to stack numbers in a sequence (e.g., a 64 next to a 32, next to a 16). This way, when you drop an 8 into another 8, it turns into a 16, which immediately merges with the existing 16 to become a 32, which merges into the 64! Keep an eye on the "next block" preview so you can plan ahead. The game ends if any single column fills up completely and crosses the danger line, leaving you no room to place the next block. Keep your grid organized and see how high a number you can achieve! Mouse/Touch: Simply click or tap anywhere on a vertical column to send the current numbered block directly into that specific lane. Q: Why did my game end? A: The game ends when one of your vertical columns is completely filled with blocks and crosses the boundary limit, meaning you can no longer place the next block. Q: Do the blocks bounce around? A: No! The blocks move strictly in straight lines within the column you selected. There is no physics-based bouncing, so you have complete control over where they land. Q: How can I score more points? A: The best way to score points is by creating combos. Plan your layout so that one merge triggers a chain reaction of subsequent merges!

controls.Controls: Mouse/Touch: Simply click or tap anywhere on a vertical column to send the current numbered block directly into that specific lane.

Designed with a vibrant, "Kawaii" 2D aesthetic, this game invites players to become the ultimate royal stylist. You can customize every detail of your chibi princess, from expressive eyes and trendy hairstyles to intricate gowns and magical accessories. But the fun doesn't stop at fashion! Royal Dream Wedding features a robust pet system where you can unlock, collect, and level up a variety of adorable kittens, each with its own unique personality and style, such as the sweet "Milk Tea" or the playful "Pudding." Whether you are designing a stunning look for a royal ceremony or managing your very own cat cafe, the game offers a serene and creative sanctuary. With daily rewards and endless combinations, it's the perfect playground for anyone who loves fashion, pets, and everything cute. Infinite Fashion Possibilities: Explore a massive wardrobe featuring thousands of combinations for eyes, hair, dresses, and accessories to create your unique chibi character. Adorable Pet System: Unlock and raise a variety of cute cats with different levels and names, adding a layer of collection and care to the gameplay. High-Level Customization: Go beyond simple outfits by adjusting facial features and expressions to give your royal character a distinct personality. Daily Rewards and Progression: Log in every day to claim coins and gems, which help you unlock rare clothing items and new feline friends. Starting your fashion journey in Royal Dream Wedding is simple and intuitive. Upon entering the game, click "Start" to begin creating your first character. You can navigate through various tabs to select the perfect eye shape, hair color, and stylish outfits. Once you are satisfied with your design, you can save your creation or start fresh. To engage with the pet system, enter the pet nursery where you use earned coins or gems to unlock new cats. As you collect more pets, you can level them up to discover even cuter breeds. Participate in daily tasks and check your limited-time bonuses to earn extra currency. The more you play, the more elaborate your wardrobe and pet collection will become, allowing you to design the royal wedding of your dreams! Tap/Click: Select items, switch tabs, and unlock new pets. Scroll: Browse through the extensive collection of clothing and accessories. Q: How do I get more coins to unlock cats? A: You can earn coins by completing character designs, claiming daily login rewards, or watching short bonus videos. Q: Can I save multiple characters? A: Yes! You can save your favorite designs to your gallery and revisit them anytime to make adjustments. Q: What happens when I level up my pets? A: Leveling up pets often unlocks higher-tier cat breeds with more intricate designs and helps you earn more rewards.

games.title: Drifting Mania
games.description: Master the art of the drift in Drifting Mania! Experience fast-paced top-down racing, unlock cool cars through customisation, and complete achievements to prove you're the drift king.
games.long_description: Drifting Mania is an exhilarating top-down racing game that strips away the complexities of traditional driving simulators to focus on one thing: the perfect drift. Set on narrow, winding tracks, the game challenges players to maintain momentum and precision as they navigate sharp turns. With its sleek 2D flat-art style and vibrant colors, Drifting Mania offers a visually refreshing and high-energy experience. Players can dive into a deep "Customisation" menu to personalize their vehicles with various colors and styles, making every race uniquely theirs. The inclusion of an extensive "Achievements" system ensures that every successful drift and milestone earned feels rewarding. Whether you are aiming for a new high score or looking to unlock every vehicle in the garage, the addictive "one-more-try" gameplay loop makes it perfect for quick breaks or long sessions. Grip the wheel, time your taps, and show the world your drifting prowess! Precision Drifting: Master the one-tap control system to execute perfect drifts around hairpin turns. Vibrant Customisation: Unlock and personalize a variety of cars with stylish colors to stand out on the track. Reward Achievements: Challenge yourself with a comprehensive achievement system that tracks your progress and skill. Smooth 2D Visuals: Enjoy clean, modern flat-design graphics that provide a high-speed, clutter-free experience. The goal of Drifting Mania is to survive on the track for as long as possible while collecting points for successful drifts. When you hit the "Play" button, your car begins to accelerate automatically along a narrow road. As you approach a corner, you must tap and hold the screen to initiate a drift. Timing is everything; releasing too early or holding for too long will send your vehicle crashing into the water or off the road. Every successful corner earned fills your score multiplier. Between races, visit the "Customisation" menu. Here, you can use the gems you've collected on the track to buy new cars or change the paint job of your current ride. Don't forget to check the "Achievements" tab frequently—completing specific tasks like "Drift 10 times in a row" will reward you with bonus currency to speed up your progress. Start with the basics, master the rhythm of the turns, and aim for the top of the leaderboard! Tap and hold to drift around corners. Release to straighten out and drive forward. Q: How do I unlock new cars? A: Collect gems during races or complete achievements to earn currency for the shop. Q: Why does my car keep crashing? A: Drifting requires precise timing. Try tapping earlier as you enter the turn to find the right arc. Q: Are there different tracks? A: The track is procedurally generated, offering a new challenge every time you play.

controls.Controls: Tap and hold to drift around corners. Release to straighten out and drive forward.

games.source_page_title: Drifting Mania - High-Octane Top-Down Drift Racing Game

games.title: Blocksss
games.description: Challenge your brain with Blocksss! Fit triangles, hexagons, and tangram pieces into unique outlines. Explore multiple modes like Equilateral and Isosceles in this relaxing logic puzzle game.
games.long_description: Blocksss is a comprehensive geometric puzzle game that invites players to master the art of spatial arrangement. Featuring a sleek and colorful interface, the game offers a massive collection of brain-teasers centered around fitting unique pieces into complex outlines. What sets Blocksss apart is its incredible variety; players can toggle between different modes including Equilateral (triangles), Tangram (classic dissection puzzles), Hexagon, and Isosceles. Each mode presents a fresh perspective on geometry, challenging you to think outside the box. The game is designed to be a meditative experience—there are no ticking clocks or high-pressure timers, just pure logical satisfaction. As you progress through hundreds of levels, the patterns become more intricate, requiring sharper focus and better visualization. Whether you're a fan of classic tangrams or looking for a modern hexagon challenge, Blocksss provides a satisfying mental workout for all ages. Multiple Game Modes: Switch between Triangle, Hexagon, and Tangram modes for diverse geometric gameplay. Hundreds of Levels: Enjoy a vast library of puzzles ranging from beginner to expert difficulty. Brain-Boosting Logic: Improve your spatial reasoning and visualization skills with every solved level. Relaxing Experience: Play at your own pace with soothing visuals and absolutely no time pressure. Starting your puzzle adventure in Blocksss is intuitive and engaging. Upon entering the game, select your preferred geometric mode—Equilateral, Tangram, Hexagon, or Isosceles. Once a level loads, you will see an empty frame in the center of the screen representing the target shape. At the bottom of the interface, several colored pieces will be waiting. Your goal is to move all these pieces into the frame so they fit perfectly without overlapping. To move a piece, simply click and drag it to your desired location within the outline. If a piece fits, it will snap into place. You must use every single piece provided to complete the level. There is no rotation required in most levels, so the challenge lies in finding the correct spatial configuration. If you find yourself stuck, you can use the Hint button (the lightbulb icon) to reveal the correct position of a piece in exchange for in-game coins. Drag and drop the colored pieces from the bottom dock into the central frame using your mouse or finger. Q: Can I rotate the pieces? A: In most modes, pieces are fixed in their orientation and cannot be rotated. Q: How do I earn more coins? A: You earn coins by successfully completing levels and reaching new milestones. Q: What if the pieces overlap? A: Pieces cannot overlap; they must fit side-by-side to fill the entire target outline.

controls.Controls: Drag and drop the colored pieces from the bottom dock into the central frame using your mouse or finger.

games.source_page_title: Blocksss - Ultimate Geometric Shape & Tangram Puzzle Collection

games.title: Cooking Dishes
games.description: Step into the kitchen in Cooking Dishes! Prepare delicious food, experience realistic DIY cooking steps, unlock new recipes, and serve adorable animal friends. Play free!
games.long_description: Welcome to Cooking Dishes, a heartwarming and incredibly relaxing cooking simulation game where you become a master chef for adorable animal friends! Dive into a beautifully hand-drawn kitchen and prepare a wide variety of delicious meals, from movie-night popcorn and crispy banana toast to juicy steaks and massive hamburgers. The game guides you through every realistic step of the culinary process: peeling ingredients, chopping meat, frying, baking, and careful plating. As you complete dishes within the specific time limit, you will unlock new, more complex recipes in your menu book. The best part? After cooking, you get to watch your cute animal customers, like the lovely otters, happily enjoy the food you made for them! With its soothing aesthetic, interactive mechanics, and stress-relieving DIY gameplay, Cooking Dishes is the perfect cozy game for foodies and animal lovers alike! Rich Recipe Collection: Unlock and cook various delicious foods like popcorn, burgers, steak, and Tom Yum Goong. Realistic DIY Cooking: Experience satisfying interactive steps like peeling, chopping, frying, and baking. Cute Animal Customers: Serve your culinary masterpieces to adorable, hand-drawn animal characters. Relaxing & Healing Vibe: Enjoy a stress-free environment with soothing aesthetics and a cozy atmosphere. Getting started in Cooking Dishes is a delightful and mouth-watering experience. Here is your recipe for success: Step 1: Choose a Recipe. Open your recipe book from the main menu. If you are a beginner, start with something simple like Popcorn. Tap on the unlocked dish to enter the kitchen. Step 2: Prepare the Ingredients. Follow the on-screen prompts (like a pointing hand icon). For popcorn, you will first need to peel the corn cob by swiping the screen. For burgers, you might need to use a knife to chop the meat into a patty. Step 3: Cook the Food. Move to the stove or oven. Turn on the heat by tapping the button, add oil and sugar, and pour in your prepared ingredients. Follow the instructions closely to fry or bake your meal perfectly. Step 4: Plate and Serve. Once the food is cooked, carefully drag it onto the plate or into the serving bucket. Add the final touches and wait for the green checkmark to confirm your perfection. Step 5: Watch and Earn. Watch the adorable cutscenes of animals (like the cute otters) enjoying your hard work! Successfully completing a dish rewards you with progress to unlock new, locked pages in your menu, giving you more delicious challenges to tackle. Tap/Click: Tap to select recipes, turn on appliances (like the stove), and use tools like a knife to chop. Swipe/Drag: Swipe to peel ingredients, and drag and drop food items into the pan or onto the serving plate. Q: Why did my cooking session end suddenly? A: Pay attention to the timer at the top center of the screen! Each dish has a specific time limit. If the countdown reaches zero before you finish all the steps, you will have to restart. Q: How do I unlock the locked dishes in the menu? A: You need to complete the available recipes and fulfill daily orders to gain experience. As you play more, the padlocks on advanced recipes like Steak or Tom Yum Goong will unlock. Q: I'm stuck and don't know what to do next. What should I do? A: Don't panic! If you are lost, click the "Hint" button (the lightbulb icon) at the bottom left of the screen. It will highlight the exact tool or ingredient you need to interact with next.

controls.Controls: Tap/Click: Tap to select recipes, turn on appliances (like the stove), and use tools like a knife to chop. Swipe/Drag: Swipe to peel ingredients, and drag and drop food items into the pan or onto the serving plate.

games.source_page_title: Cooking Dishes: Cute Animal Chef & Food Cooking Simulator Game

games.title: Race Master
games.description: Experience two distinct worlds: intense Multiplayer races and unique Solo obstacle tracks. Master the art of steering in Race Master!
games.long_description: Race Master offers two fundamentally different racing experiences in one high-octane package. In Multiplayer Mode, you face off against real rivals on high-speed circuits where positioning and nitro management are key to victory. However, switching to Solo Training reveals an entirely different set of challenges: these tracks are meticulously designed as obstacle courses, featuring unique barriers and traps not found in the multiplayer arena. This mode is a pure test of your reflexes and precision steering, allowing you to master vehicle control under extreme conditions. The car accelerates automatically, leaving you to focus on navigating the distinct layouts of each mode. Whether you're dodging exclusive solo-mode hazards or drafting behind opponents in a global sprint, the vibrant 3D visuals and intuitive mouse controls ensure a thrilling ride. It's not just about speed—it's about adapting to the unique architecture of every race. Unique Solo Obstacle Courses：The Solo mode features specialized tracks with complex hazards, such as moving barriers and narrow gaps, specifically designed to sharpen your steering precision and reflexes. Competitive Multiplayer Layouts：Multiplayer tracks are optimized for high-speed drafting and overtaking. The obstacles here are strategically placed to balance the competition among real players on the road. Master Two Distinct Worlds：Learn to adapt as you switch modes. Each environment demands a different tactical approach, making the game a comprehensive training ground for all types of racing fans. Select Mode: Choose Multiplayer to compete for rank against real players, or Solo to tackle specialized obstacle-dense tracks. Navigation: The car accelerates automatically. Your goal is to steer through the gaps between static obstacles. In Solo mode, these obstacles are placed in much tighter, more challenging layouts. Turbo Charge: Drive through Blue Nitro Canisters to trigger automatic speed boosts. Chain these together to maintain maximum velocity. No Collisions: Any contact with the yellow barriers will drastically slow you down. Success depends on finding the cleanest racing line through the fixed hazards. PC:Mouse Move (Left/Right): Steer your car. Auto-Nitro: Boosts are triggered automatically upon collecting items. Mobile: Slide (Left/Right): Swipe your finger to navigate through obstacles and rivals. Auto-Drive: The car moves forward on its own; you only control the direction. Q: Can I play with friends? A: Yes! You can join the Multiplayer mode to race against other players or practice independently in the Solo Training area. Q: Why are the obstacles different in Solo and Multiplayer? A: Solo tracks focus on skill-based dodging (Training), while Multiplayer tracks are designed for balanced player-vs-player competition.

controls.Controls: PC:Mouse Move (Left/Right): Steer your car. Auto-Nitro: Boosts are triggered automatically upon collecting items. Mobile: Slide (Left/Right): Swipe your finger to navigate through obstacles and rivals. Auto-Drive: The car moves forward on its own; you only control the direction.

games.source_page_title: Race Master: Multi-Race & Solo Obstacle Challenge

games.title: Ball 2048
games.description: Defend your solitary tower against endless waves of goblin enemies! Earn resources, upgrade your attack and health, and see how long you can survive in this addictive idle defense game.
games.long_description: Welcome to Mini Defense, a thrilling strategy game where your goal is to protect a single, central tower against relentless waves of invading enemies. As the commander, you must oversee the auto-firing defenses and strategically use the resources you gather from fallen foes to upgrade your tower. The game features a satisfying incremental progression system. You start with basic attacks, but by collecting 'meat' during battles, you can enhance your attack power, attack speed, and attack range. Beyond the battlefield, use coins and gems to permanently upgrade your tower's health, regeneration, and damage reduction in the workshop. With its vibrant cartoon graphics, intuitive interface, and addictive idle mechanics, this game offers endless entertainment. Can you build an impenetrable fortress and conquer all 50 waves to unlock new worlds? Endless Waves: Defend your tower against increasingly difficult waves of goblin enemies. Incremental Upgrades: Use collected resources to boost your attack damage, speed, and range continuously. Permanent Enhancements: Visit the workshop to permanently improve your tower's health, regeneration, and defense stats. Idle Mechanics: Your tower attacks automatically, allowing you to focus on strategy and upgrades. Vibrant Graphics: Enjoy colorful, cartoon-style 2D graphics that make the battlefield come alive. Playing this game is simple but requires strategic thinking. When you start, your central tower will automatically begin shooting at the approaching goblins. Each time an enemy is defeated, they drop "meat". This meat is your primary resource during a battle. Keep an eye on the bottom of the screen where you'll see upgrade options for "Attack", "Attack Range", and "Attack Speed". As soon as you have enough meat, tap these buttons to instantly boost your tower's combat capabilities. The wave number at the top shows your progress. As waves increase, enemies become tougher. If your tower's health reaches zero, you lose the battle. However, death is not the end! After a defeat, you will be rewarded with coins based on your performance. You can then go to the "Workshop" tab from the main menu. Here, you use those coins to purchase permanent upgrades for your tower, such as increased maximum "Health", "Health Regeneration", and "Damage Reduction". These permanent upgrades ensure that you start your next battle much stronger. The goal is to survive all 50 waves to unlock a new world. Keep battling, collecting resources, and upgrading your tower to become unstoppable! Tap to Upgrade: Simply tap the upgrade buttons at the bottom of the screen to enhance your tower's stats using collected resources. The tower shoots automatically, so no manual targeting is required. Q: What happens when my tower is destroyed? A: You will lose the current battle, but you will earn coins based on the waves cleared. You can use these coins in the workshop for permanent upgrades before trying again. Q: What is the difference between meat and coins? A: Meat is used for temporary upgrades during a battle. Coins are used in the Workshop for permanent upgrades that last across all future battles. Q: How do I unlock the next world? A: You need to successfully survive and defeat all enemies up to Wave 50 to unlock the new world and face new challenges.

controls.Controls: Tap to Upgrade: Simply tap the upgrade buttons at the bottom of the screen to enhance your tower's stats using collected resources. The tower shoots automatically, so no manual targeting is required.
